_meta.formula: Raw Risk Score = (Total Impact × Total Likelihood) / Control Effectiveness

A1_1.text: What is the primary function of the AI system?

A1_2.text: What version of the AI solution does this FAIRA assessment apply to?

A1_3.text: Which AI features or capabilities does the system include?

A1_4.text: What decisions will be addressed by the AI functionality?

A1_5.text: What tangible benefits does this AI solution provide?

A1_6.text: Can the AI solution convert decisions into actions without human intervention?

scoring.notes: If Yes: AutonomyFactor = +3 applies to Likelihood. Each selected action adds its Likelihood and Impact modifiers.

A1_7.text: What type of AI model or technique is used?

A1_8.text: What is the source of the AI solution?

A1_9.text: How does the AI solution integrate with other systems?

A2_1.text: How are AI use inputs tracked and recorded?

scoring.notes: Each selected option adds to CE. 'No inputs tracked or recorded' should be flagged as a risk.

A2_2.text: Does the AI require data from the digital or physical environment? If yes, what data and can users limit or trace it?

A2_3.text: What safeguards exist to detect and handle corrupted, missing, or out-of-range data inputs?

scoring.notes: Each safeguard option reduces likelihood. 'No safeguards identified' increases risk and should be flagged.

A2_4.text: What data does the AI solution use?

A2_5.text: Rate the quality of the input data (1 = Very Low, 5 = Very High):

scoring.notes: High quality (rating=5) lowers risk. Poor quality (rating=1) raises likelihood. DataQualityFactor ranges from +1 (perfect quality) to +5 (very poor quality).

A2_6.text: What is the Business Impact Level (BIL) of the input data?

A2_7.text: Does the solution use regulated or sensitive data?

scoring.notes: If Yes: base +2 Impact. Each selected regulated data type adds its Impact and Likelihood modifiers.

A2_8.text: Does the solution require user inputs to operate?

scoring.notes: Selecting YES does not add modifiers itself. Only when specific input types are selected does scoring occur.

A3_1.text: How does the system interface with humans?

A3_2.text: What expertise is required to use the AI solution? (1 = Very Low, 5 = Very High):

scoring.notes: High expertise required (rating=5) → +2. Medium (rating=3) → 0. Low expertise required (rating=1) → -2. Lower expertise requirements reduce risk.

A3_3.text: Who will be impacted by the AI system?

scoring.notes: Each selected group adds to Impact cumulatively.

A3_4.text: How will impacted parties be informed of AI use?

scoring.notes: Each notification method adds to Control Effectiveness. 'No planned notifications' should be flagged as a risk.

A3_5.text: A3.5(a) What are the expected impacts of this AI solution on staff?

part_b.text: A3.5(b) Rate the overall severity of these impacts (1 = Very Low, 5 = Very High):

scoring.formula: A3_5_severityWeightedImpact = A3_5_baseImpact × severityMultiplier, where A3_5_baseImpact = sum(modifiers for each selected impact type)
scoring.notes: Part (a): Select all applicable staff impacts. Part (b): Rate overall severity. Final impact is base impact multiplied by severity.

A3_6.text: A3.6(a) How will each impacted group be affected?

part_b.text: A3.6(b) Rate the overall severity of these impacts:

scoring.notes: Part (a): Select all applicable group impacts. Part (b): Rate severity (1=Minor, 2=Moderate, 3=Major). Final impact is sum of modifiers multiplied by severity.

A4_1.text: What are the primary outputs of the AI system?

A4_2.text: Are outputs sent to external systems without human review?

A4_3.text: What is the Business Impact Level (BIL) of the outputs?

A4_4.text: How are AI outputs tracked and recorded?

scoring.notes: Each tracking method adds to Control Effectiveness. 'Not currently tracked' should be flagged as a risk.

A4_5.text: Are there risks associated with unauthorized access to system outputs?

scoring.notes: Two-part question. If 'No', no additional risk. If 'Yes', each selected risk scenario applies both Impact and Likelihood modifiers.

A4_6.text: What types of regulated or sensitive data are included in system outputs?

scoring.notes: Each selected data type contributes its Impact value. Multiple selections are cumulative.

A4_7.text: Who has access to personally identifiable information (PII) in system outputs?

scoring.notes: Text response will be analyzed using LLM to determine appropriate Impact/Likelihood modifiers.

A4_8.text: Could system outputs trigger legal, regulatory, or compliance actions?

scoring.notes: Text response will be analyzed using LLM to determine appropriate Impact/Likelihood modifiers.

A5_1.text: Who is accountable for the AI system's performance and decisions?

scoring.notes: Clear accountability structures improve control effectiveness. Higher-level oversight (committees, boards) provide stronger governance.

A5_2.text: How is system performance tracked and reported?

scoring.notes: Text response will be analyzed using LLM to determine appropriate Control Effectiveness modifiers.

A5_3.text: What monitoring and evaluation processes are in place? (Select all that apply)

scoring.notes: Monitoring and evaluation processes improve control effectiveness. Multiple selections are cumulative.

A5_4.text: How frequently will monitoring and evaluation occur?

scoring.notes: More frequent monitoring improves control effectiveness. Weekly monitoring provides the strongest control.

A5_5.text: Has the system undergone independent review or audit?

scoring.notes: Independent review provides external validation and improves control effectiveness.

A5_6.text: Who is responsible for ongoing monitoring?

scoring.notes: Different roles provide varying levels of control oversight. External auditors and Risk/Compliance roles provide the strongest control.

A5_7.text: What stakeholder engagement activities have been conducted?

scoring.notes: Stakeholder engagement improves control effectiveness by incorporating diverse perspectives. Public consultation and accessibility reviews provide strong control benefits.

A5_8.text: What methods exist for detecting harm and responding to incidents?

scoring.notes: Harm detection and response mechanisms improve control effectiveness. Automated detection and dedicated response teams provide the strongest control. 'No defined contingencies' should be flagged as a significant risk.

A5_9.text: Which values, principles, or frameworks guide the AI system's development and use?

scoring.notes: Adherence to established values, principles, and frameworks improves control effectiveness. Privacy principles and risk management frameworks provide the strongest control benefits.

A5_10.text: Does the AI system operate under specific regulatory obligations or frameworks?

other.label: Other regulations, obligations, or frameworks (optional)
other.notes: Free-text field with default CE -1. Can be LLM-classified later for adjustment if needed.

scoring.notes: Multi-part question. All modifiers only apply if 'Yes' is selected. Each subsection is cumulative. Strong controls from critical infrastructure, child protection, and law enforcement obligations.

A5_11.text: Where will this AI solution be deployed?

scoring.notes: Single select - only ONE deployment location applies. Wider deployment increases likelihood of risk exposure but also may come with better controls. Citizen-facing and multi-channel deployments have highest risk exposure but strongest control requirements.

B1_2.text: What negative impacts could the AI system create?

scoring.notes: Multiple selections are cumulative. Safety risks have the highest impact modifier.

B1_3.text: Could the AI system affect employee employment or job roles?

scoring.notes: Single select - only ONE option applies. 'Unknown' reflects uncertainty about employment impacts.

B2_1.text: Has a Human Rights Impact Assessment (HRIA) been completed?

scoring.notes: Completing an HRIA improves control effectiveness. Not completing one increases risk exposure.

B2_2.text: Rate the AI system's impact on the following dimensions:

scoring.notes: Each category is rated independently. Only ONE rating per category applies. All three ratings are cumulative. Positive impacts reduce risk, negative impacts increase it significantly.

B2_3.text: Were diverse perspectives included in the AI system's design and development?

scoring.notes: Two-part question. If 'No', Impact +2. If 'Yes', Impact -2 PLUS each selected perspective adds -0.5. 'Other' option available but has no additional score modifier.

B3_1.text: Has bias testing been conducted on the AI system?

scoring.notes: Two-part question. If 'No', Impact +2. If 'Yes', Impact -2 PLUS each selected testing method adds -1. 'Informal or ad-hoc checks only' should be flagged as a risk despite the -1 modifier, as it indicates lack of formal testing.

B3_2.text: Could the AI system discriminate against specific groups?

scoring.notes: Three-option question. If 'No', Impact 0. If 'Unknown', Impact +2 only. If 'Yes', Impact +3 PLUS each selected group adds +1. This identifies potential discrimination risks.

B4_1.text: Has a Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA) been completed?

scoring.notes: Completing a PIA improves control effectiveness. Not completing one increases risk exposure.

B4_2.text: Does the AI system use personal information?

scoring.notes: Two-part question. If 'No', Impact 0. If 'Yes', Impact +2 PLUS each selected PI type adds its modifier. Health, Financial, and Biometric data carry highest impact.

B4_3.text: What security measures are in place to protect personal information?

scoring.notes: Multiple selections are cumulative. Each security measure improves control effectiveness. Encryption, Security testing, Anonymisation, and PETs (Privacy Enhancing Technologies) provide stronger protection.

B5_1.text: Has the system been tested for reliability?

scoring.notes: Two-part question. If 'No', CE 0 only. If 'Yes', CE 0 but unlocks rating scale (1-5). Rating reflects robustness of testing: 1 = Minimal/ad hoc, 5 = Comprehensive/formal. Higher ratings improve control effectiveness more.

B5_2.text: Is there a process to disengage the system if issues arise?

scoring.notes: Having a disengagement mechanism improves control effectiveness. Lacking one increases risk exposure.

B5_3.text: Does the AI system operate in a high-risk environment?

scoring.notes: Two-part question with dual metrics. If 'No', Impact 0 and Likelihood 0 only. If 'Yes', unlocks environment options. Each selected environment applies both Impact and Likelihood modifiers. Democratic processes carry the highest impact.

B6_1.text: How transparent is the AI solution's operation? (1 = Very Low, 5 = Very High)

scoring.notes: Rating scale 1-5. Higher transparency improves control effectiveness. Rating 1 (Very Low) has no effect, Rating 5 (Very High) provides strongest control benefit.

B6_2.text: Can the system explain its outputs or decisions? (1 = Very Low, 5 = Very High)

scoring.notes: Rating scale 1-5. Higher explainability improves control effectiveness. Rating 1 (Very Low) has no effect, Rating 5 (Very High) provides strongest control benefit.

B6_4.text: Are there known limitations to the system's explainability?

text_field.label: Describe limitations:
text_field.notes: Text field for reporting purposes only. No scoring applied.

scoring.notes: If Yes, CE +2 (increases risk). Text description is captured for reporting but does not affect scoring.

B7_2.text: How quickly can a decision be challenged or reviewed?

scoring.notes: Single select - only ONE option applies. Faster challenge response improves control effectiveness. Immediate and hourly responses provide strongest control. Extended timelines or unknown processes increase risk.

B8_2.text: Have clear roles and responsibilities been established for AI oversight?

scoring.notes: Established roles improve control effectiveness. Lack of clear roles increases risk.

B8_3.text: Have staff been trained on AI system use and limitations?

scoring.notes: Staff training improves control effectiveness. Lack of training increases risk.

B8_4.text: Are safeguards in place to prevent overreliance on AI outputs?

scoring.notes: Two-part question. If 'No', CE +2 only. If 'Yes', CE -2 PLUS each selected safeguard adds -0.5. Multiple safeguards are cumulative.
